programme.desc: Jackie steals a healing stone but loses his way/A girl's zoo visit transforms her parents' relationship/Bob enters a strange bar post-accident.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Little Boy Lost/Wish Bank/Nightcrawlers
programme.desc: Photographer faces dilemma & encounters familiar boy/Janice gets lamp with wish restrictions/Trooper's diner stop unveils vet's nightmares.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Ye Gods
programme.desc: Cupid arrives in the modern world. A love spell for his target does not work as well as he hopes.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: If She Dies
programme.desc: A year after his wife died a man is involved in a car accident that leaves his young daughter in a coma. On his way home the man has a vision.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Examination Day/A Message From Charity
programme.desc: In the far future, twelve-year-old Dickie must take the government intelligence test/A 16-year old in 1985 finds himself in telepathic contact with a girl in 1700. Her knowledge of the future gets her accused of being a witch.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Teacher's Aide/Paladin of the Lost Hour
programme.desc: A teacher on a violent and gang-infested high school has trouble controlling her students/A Vietnam vet named Billy saves an old man named Gaspar from a mugging at a cemetery.
programme.sub-title: Teacher's Aide/Paladin of the Lost Hour

programme.title: A Century of Science Fiction: Amazing Inventions
programme.desc: Time machines, disintegrator machines, shrinking rays - they're all here, along with many more of sci-fi's greatest inventions.

programme.title: A Century of Science Fiction: Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: Take a look back at A.I. history in film and decide whether computers are our friends or they're all H.A.L. from 2001: A Space Odyssey.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: The Prisoner (REDUX)
programme.desc: Travis and Callie pick up a psychiatric patient with amnesia, who grows to remember Travis and wants him dead. In parallel, the new Orchard leader Tristan Catchpole set his sights on Travis, who may have some of his Cluster genes activated.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Kate (REDUX)
programme.desc: After the Trans-Utopian collides with a mine, Percy, unhappy with Caravaggio's recent crisis performance, creates a female Al program with more intuition, but it quickly develops too much independence... and an attraction to Travis.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Rivals (REDUX)
programme.desc: Callie's irritation with the Trans-Utopian's ongoing technical problems is aggravated when the sleek bounty hunting ship Seattle and its debonair captain rescue the crew from a problem. They owe him, but the whole situation doesn't feel right.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Heir and the Spare (REDUX)
programme.desc: The crew arrest a con-man preying on older women. But the prisoner has a dark secret and a genetic link to Marcus. Meanwhile, Percy's secret parallel search for Dante begins to wear on her; we fear for the consequences to her health and judgement.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Just Politics (REDUX)
programme.desc: Rudolfo becomes suspicious of a trade minister the Trans-Utopian is transport­ing to the Manheim Asteroid Belt to clinch a deal. Rudolfo will benefit from the deal, but it may be too good to be true.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Negative Energy (REDUX)
programme.desc: Marcus believes he can convert the Trans-Utopian's hyper drive with negative energy instead of antimatter, rendering it safer, but hey will need Durenium to test it. He seeks a seller of this rare and - in some orbits - illegal, element.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: License to Fill (REDUX)
programme.desc: A vengeful bureaucrat has the Trans-Utopian crew charged for a license violation. Travis must defend himself in court, where his dubious past is revealed, placing him in grave danger.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Hyperspace I (REDUX)
programme.desc: Marcus finds an obscure Divinity Cluster scientist who may hold a key to new ways of altering our relationship with space-time. He succeeds all too well.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Hyperspace II (REDUX)
programme.desc: The Trans-Utopian's crew is trapped in separate folds of space-time with a ticking-clock to rejoin into one spacetime. Travis will meet Dante while Percy and Dante up a risky plan to extricate themselves from their respective hyperspatial traps.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: The Divinity Cluster (REDUX)
programme.desc: Bounty Hunter Dante Montana encounters a dangerous old "frenemy," while his partner, Luc, tracks a man who may hold the key to the Divinity Cluster, human genes with extraterrestrial origins.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Joe Post silences a rat in his gang, inspired by Goodfellas, after suspecting betrayal.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Matthew Tinling tortures his housemate for money, inspired by Jigsaw from SAW.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Elena Lobacheva joins a group to kill homeless people, inspired by Bride of Chucky.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Fatal Flaw
programme.desc: Parents rush their baby to the hospital, but she tragically dies in her mother’s arms. Now, Dr. G must help these devastated parents understand what happened.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Deadly Dive
programme.desc: A train engineer panics when he spots a man lying on the tracks. He blows the whistle, but the train can’t stop in time. It’s up to Dr. G to piece together how Andy Santana died.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: Deadly Decent
programme.desc: It’s up to Dr. G, along with the National Transportation Safety Board, to piece together how and why a plane crashed, leaving the pilot dead.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner: A Deadly Deal
programme.desc: Reed Baley is found unconscious the morning after his bachelor party. Now, it’s up to Dr. G to determine if alcohol was to blame or if there was another cause of death.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Paul Bint – The Chameleon Con Artist
programme.desc: Dubbed the British Frank Abagnale, Bint committed more than 500 offences including impersonating people.
programme.sub-title: Paul Bint – The Chameleon Con Artist

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Robert Hendy-Freegard – The Terrorist Trickster
programme.desc: Dubbed “The Most Evil Conman Ever” by the British press, Hendy-Freegard terrorized victims into believing they were terrorist targets.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Michael Hammond – The Fantasist Con
programme.desc: He posed as a playboy, a detective, a top surgeon, millionaire property developer, royal confident and boyfriend of Renee Zellweger.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Nick Gage – The Lying Lothario
programme.desc: Fantasist Gage preyed on lonely women he would meet on dating sites.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Danger in the Woods
programme.desc: Three teenagers accompany a deliveryman to a densely wooded area for a drinking party that, before long, becomes a nightmare. Things take a terrifying turn when one of teens attacks the others.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Hate Crime
programme.desc: A young Orthodox Jewish man is in Pittsburgh to celebrate Passover with family when he is gunned down simply because of the way he is dressed.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Hostage
programme.desc: A man robs an armoured car at gunpoint and holds a massage parlor worker hostage. As police investigate, they find startling links to a series of robberies, all taking place during the Christmas season.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Secret Life
programme.desc: In Calgary, Alberta, a beautiful Ethiopian woman is found brutally strangled. The victim’s husband seems genuinely distraught over his wife’s death, but there is something strangely suspicious about him.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Flying Bandit
programme.desc: In 1986, an American becomes one of Canada’s most prolific bank and jewellery bandits after he pulls off one of the biggest heists in Canadian history. As more robberies occur, the police become more determined to catch the mastermind behind them all.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Cold Hit
programme.desc: In 1994, a troubled single mother is found raped and murdered in her apartment. Was it one of the volatile men in her life? All possible suspects are eliminated and the case goes cold for three years, until a nine-year old girl is brutally raped.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Hustler
programme.desc: Three people meet - the son of a wealthy Frenchman, a Vancouver businessman looking for investors. Unbeknownst to two of them, they are the latest victims of a notorious international con man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.desc: On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had found her unconscious in the bathroom with a mysterious plastic bag next to her
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)
programme.desc: On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up.
programme.sub-title: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Fatal Student Night (Ste´phane Kameugne Case)
programme.desc: On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school
programme.sub-title: A Fatal Student Night (Ste´phane Kameugne Case)

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: Recruited by MI6, British businessman Greville Wynne works with Soviet spy Oleg Penkovsky to obtain intelligence on the Cuban Missile Crisis.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange (Benedict Cumberbatch) and his colleague, Daniel Domscheit-Berg (Daniel Brühl), provide a platform for whistle-blowers to leak covert data anonymously and expose government secrets and corporate crimes.

programme.title: A Dangerous Method
programme.desc: Dr. Carl Jung treats Sabina, a beautiful and unbalanced patient, using the methods of his mentor, Dr. Sigmund Freud, but a rivalry between the doctors forms as each falls under her spell.

programme.title: Eddie the Eagle
programme.desc: Guided by a rebellious and charismatic coach (Hugh Jackman), British ski jumper Michael "Eddie" Edwards (Taron Egerton) trains for the 1988 Winter Olympics in Calgary, Alberta.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: When a car bomb explodes in a downtown parking garage, a newly reinstated Duncan goes rogue in an effort to prove himself.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: The officers of Division 15 work to track down Ted McDonald; but even after catching him, they realize Ted has more targets set to explode out there.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy and Sam return to work; Andy is attacked at Traci's apartment and the Sex Crimes Unit tries to take over the case.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy contemplates her future with Sam after learning of heartbreaking news; she meets a teenager in need of protection.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: A riot erupts at an over-capacity women's correctional facility while Andy, Juliet, Nick and Gail transfer inmates; a dangerous prisoner tries to prove her innocence to a trapped Andy and Juliet.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Nick receives information on his tragic past and goes off the grid to track someone down; he is forced to tell Juliet about his secrets.

programme.title: The Fall
programme.desc: A bedridden patient (Lee Pace) captivates a hospitalized girl (Catinca Untaru) with a fantastic tale involving heroes, mystics and villains on a desert island.

programme.title: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: Knights (Nicolas Cage, Ron Perlman) escort an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in the hope of ending the pestilence ravaging Europe.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: Betrayed by his stepfather, the King, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom.

programme.title: South Park: Fantastic Easter Special
programme.desc: Fantastic Easter Special: Stan sets out to find a reason for painting Easter eggs and discovers his father is part of a society called "The Hare Club For Men", but all is not what it seems. (S11, E05)

programme.title: South Park: D-Yikes!
programme.desc: D-Yikes!: Ms. Garrison decides that she is a lesbian after getting dumped again but hell breaks loose when her new favourite lesbian bar faces a takeover from Persians in a '300' stylee. (S11, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Night of the Living Homeless
programme.desc: Night of the Living Homeless: When a plague of homeless people hits South Park, the boys devise a plan to move them on whilst the adults panic like they're in a zombie movie. (S11, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Le Petite Tourette: Cartman experiences bliss when he discovers that, by pretending to have Tourettes, he can say whatever he likes to whoever he likes! Naturally, national TV beckons. (S11, E08)

programme.title: South Park: More Cr*p
programme.desc: More Cr*p: Inadvertently, Randy breaks the world record for the 'biggest cr*p'! Bono, the previous holder, is determined to regain his crown - but he has a dark secret which may stop him. (S11, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode I
programme.desc: Imaginationland - Episode I: The boys find themselves in a magical land where all of the world's imagination is laid out before them. (S11, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode II
programme.desc: Imaginationland - Episode II: The government are holding Stan and Kyle captive, to find out how they got into Imaginationland. Butters is in trouble with evil creatures like Snarf! (S11, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode III
programme.desc: Imaginationland- Episode III: Stan and Butters are stuck in Imaginationland fighting for their lives, while Cartman goes all the way to the supreme court to get Kyle to pay up on their bet. (S11, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Guitar Queer-o: Stan and Kyle are set to hit big time with their skills on computer game Guitar Hero. Their manager convinces Stan that Kyle is holding him back. Will the "band" break up? (S11, E13)

programme.title: South Park: The List
programme.desc: The List: The boys steal a list from the girls which rates their looks from the cutest to the ugliest. Spirits plummet, while for others egos inflate! Can the ghost of Abraham Lincoln help? (S11, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Tonsil Trouble
programme.desc: Tonsil Trouble: A botched blood transfusion results in Cartman getting AIDS. How far will he go to find a cure? Kyle had better watch out... (S12, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Britney's New Look
programme.desc: Britney's New Look: The media circus arrives in South Park as Britney Spears hides in the town. After a photo of her urinating on a ladybug sells for $100,000 the boys have a brain wave. (S12, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Major B**bage
programme.desc: Major B**bage: The hysterical parents of South Park have another reason to panic after 'cheesing' becomes popular among kids. Kenny becomes addicted to the out-of-this-world hallucinations. (S12, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Canada on Strike
programme.desc: Canada on Strike: Canada is brought to the brink of collapse after a drawn out strike in pursuit of 'some of that internet money'. Can the boys save the day with a "YouToob" sensation? (S12, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Eek, A Pen*s!
programme.desc: Eek, A Pen*s! Ms. Garrison wants to become a man again, so whilst she is away Cartman becomes the sub teacher. It's not long before Cartman is teaching innercity kids the fun of cheating! (S12, E05)

programme.desc: Stan se vuelve adicto al nuevo juego móvil de Terrance y Phillip intenta convencer a sus amigos de que es el mejor juego de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan investiga por qué son decorados los huevos de Pascua, y qué tienen que ver los conejos y los huevos con la muerte de Jesús por sus pecados, por lo que se adentra en una sociedad bizarra con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman encuentra una manera única de tratar con el síndrome de Asperger. Mientras tanto, Stan no parece recuperar su vida a la normalidad, no importa cuánto se esfuerce.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan tiene un nuevo perro llamado Sparky que resulta ser gay, por lo que todos sus compañeros se burlan de él. Cuando Sparky se va de casa, Stan lo busca en el Santuario de Animales del Gran Gay Al y aprende algo sobre la homosexualidad.
programme.sub-title: El gran crucero del Gran Gay Al

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El abuelo de Stan cumple 102 años y quiere suicidarse, pero al no poder hacerlo, le pide a Stan que lo ayude.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El abuelo de Stan le regala una corbata que compró en un programa de ventas por 6 mil dólares. Stan trata de venderla en una casa de empeño, pero nadie le ofrece más de 15 dólares.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan intenta borrar su cuenta de Facebook, pero acaba envuelto en el mundo virtual de la red social. Mientras, Kyle agrega a sus amistades a un niño nada popular y comienza a perder amigos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se van de caza con Jimbo, el tío de Stan, y su viejo amigo Ned. Mientras tanto, un volcán está a punto de hacer erupción y la alcaldesa McDaniels aprovecha la oportunidad para promocionar al pueblo de South Park en televisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan quiere aumentar la conciencia acerca del bullying y para eso hace un video de baile que se vuelve popular en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Butters es víctima del abuso de su cruel abuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle se obsesionan tanto con Guitar Hero que llegan al punto de romper récords, lo que hace que Stan considere llegar más lejos consiguiendo un compañero diferente.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan no puede parar de guardar cosas innecesarias en su armario y, al ser enviado con el Señor Mackey para tratar su problema, se da cuenta de que él consejero de la escuela tiene el mismo trastorno de acumulación compulsiva que él.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Todos creen que Cartman está demasiado gordo, entonces deciden mandarlo a un ''Campamento de Gordos'' para que baje de peso. Por otro lado, Kenny acepta cualquier tipo de reto a cambio de dinero.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se hace pasar por transexual para poder usar el baño de las niñas en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Randy lleva una doble vida, consiguiendo fama como la famosa cantante adolescente Lorde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, el nuevo guardián del pasillo en la escuela de South Park, se toma su nuevo cargo demasiado en serio. Mientras tanto, Ike, el hermanito de Kyle, comienza una relación romántica con su maestra de jardín de infantes.
programme.sub-title: Una maestra tiene sexo con un niño

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de que una rutina de tonsilectomía sale horriblemente mal, Cartman se enfrenta cara a cara con su propia mortalidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman promueve el odio en la escuela hacia los niños con cabello rojo, pecas y piel pálida, diciendo que no tienen alma y no sobreviven al sol. Kyle, indignado, decide convertirlo en uno.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando Damián, el hijo de Satanás, llega a South Park, él y su padre anuncian que la batalla final con Jesús se realizará en una lucha de boxeo que decidirá quién es el más fuerte.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison le explica a la clase la Teoría de la Evolución, aunque está totalmente en contra de esa postura. Mientras tanto, Cartman no puede esperar a que llegue el día del lanzamiento de una consola de videojuegos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al ver a un chico con el síndrome de Tourette en una juguetería, Cartman se obsesiona con el tema y se percata de que puede decir lo que quiera sin consecuencias, por lo que se aprovecha de eso.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: South Park es invadido por hippies y Cartman trata de eliminarlos, tratándolos como si fueran una plaga. Mientras tanto, los hippies les están "lavando el cerebro" a Kyle, Stan y Kenny. Cartman es ahora la única esperanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se infiltra en la Agencia de Seguridad Nacional porque cree que lo están espiando, y no le gusta lo que encuentra en su expediente personal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Para vengarse de la profesora de arte, los chicos cubren su casa con papel higiénico. Cartman considera matar a Kyle para que él no los delate.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A Cartman no le queda otra que admitir que esta gordo, pero en lugar de hacer dieta para bajar de peso comienza a movilizarse en un scooter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Toda su vida, el sueño de Cartman ha sido ser piloto de NASCAR y está dispuesto a hacer todo lo posible para que esto ocurra.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños roban dientes a los niños menos afortunados y los venden al hada de los dientes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le cuenta a sus amigos sobre un extraño sueño que tuvo en donde unos ''visitantes'' lo abducen y le ponen una sonda anal. Pero al parecer, no fue sólo un sueño, ya que algo está desollando a las vacas del pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El restaurante favorito de Cartman ha cerrado y ha sido reemplazado por una tienda que vende marihuana medicinal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van de excursión al planetario y un empleado les lava el cerebro con efectos visuales para que quieran volver allí. Mientras, Cartman sólo se preocupa por ganar un casting para salir en el nuevo comercial de “Quesitos Poofs”.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert debería dejar las comidas engordantes

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.
programme.sub-title: El misterio del mojón en el urinal

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison ha decidido hacerse un cambio de sexo y ahora se siente como una verdadera mujer. Mientras tanto, Kyle quiere hacerse una cirugía para ser negro y poder jugar en el equipo de básquetbol.
programme.sub-title: La nueva vagina del Señor Garrison

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un día de diversión en el parque acuático se torna mortal para los niños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Nueva Jersey se está expandiendo rápidamente y South Park está en peligro de convertirse en la siguiente ciudad en ser invadida. Randy y los chicos intentarán evitarlo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle está muy enfermo y su madre trata de curarlo con medicinas naturales de una curandera y sus colaboradores "nativos americanos”. Mientras, el señor Garrison es despedido y se convierte en un escritor de novelas románticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy propone un plan para arreglar la situación económica mundial. Mientras tanto, Stan intenta devolver una máquina para hacer margaritas, y un salvador inesperado hace el último sacrificio para resolver los problemas de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En "Imaginaciónlandia", Stan y Butters luchan contra un ejército de fuerzas imaginarias. La Suprema Corte declara que las criaturas imaginarias no son reales y planean destruir "Imaginaciónlandia".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La última de las pruebas científicas revela que algunos de los chicos de South Park tiene un problema de adicción al sexo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle firma un contrato con la empresa Apple sin leerlo previamente. Mientras tanto, Cartman enloquece a su mamá porque ésta no le compro un iPad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El show de Cartman es tendencia, mientras que el país se prepara para vivir la fiesta mas espectacular jamás vista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle quiere jugar a los videojuegos con su hermano menor. Pero cuando Ike no quiere jugar más con él, Kyle teme que la próxima generación lo haya superado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los japoneses están realizando ataques con el fin de aniquilar a todos los delfines y ballenas del planeta. Ante esta situación, Stan decide toma medidas para detener la matanza.

programme.sub-title: La loca aventura de los maltratos

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Unas Navidades de mierda
programme.desc: Mr. Hankey pasa de la Navidad totalmente.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Scott Tenorman debe morir
programme.desc: Stan hará un llamamiento a todos sus amigos para que luchen unidos contra el ilusionista David Blane e impidan el suicidio en masa que está preparando.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Golpea al aficionado
programme.desc: Cartman tendrá sus primeros pelos púbicos, además de una gran decepción.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Terrance y Philip: detrás del pedo
programme.desc: Los chicos juntarán a Terrance y Philip para que actúen en las festividades del Día de la Tierra de South Park. Pero Terrance está en plan obeso mórbido y Phillip ni siquiera aparece.
programme.sub-title: Terrance y Philip: detrás del pedo

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Cartmanlandia
programme.desc: Cartman hereda un millón de dólares de su abuela. Con ellos, hará realidad uno de los mayores sueños de su vida: construir un parque de atracciones que se llamará ¡Cartmanland!

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Uso adecuado del condón
programme.desc: Los niños de South Park serán instruidos sobre prácticas sexuales ni más ni menos que por Mr Mackey.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Toallín
programme.desc: Los chicos se volverán literalmente locos con su nuevo juego de ordenador. Aparición estelar de Toallín.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Osama Bin Laden tiene calzoncillos pedorros
programme.desc: Los chicos de South Park han recaudado dinero para ayudar a los niños en Afganistán. Y el gobierno creerá que el regalo de agradecimiento de los niños afganos está contaminado con antrax.
programme.sub-title: Osama Bin Laden tiene calzoncillos pedorros

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Cómo comerte el culo
programme.desc: Kenny aparecerá un todos los cartones de leche del país, como 'desaparecido'. Todo obra de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Aquí viene el vecindario
programme.desc: Token está harto de ser el único niño rico del pueblo, e intentará atraer a nuevas familias ricas para que vayan a South Park.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Kenny muere
programme.desc: En un episodio muy especial de South Park, Cartman peleará hasta la muerte para que Kenny siga con vida.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Jugando con la ternera
programme.desc: Los chicos secuestran a unos terneros para evitar que se conviertan en unos deliciosos y jugosos filetes, pero tienen un enfrentamiento con la policía.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: El nuevo tráiler de la película de Terrance y Philip
programme.desc: Todos los niños de South Park están como locos por ver el primer tráiler de la última película de Terrance y Phillip.
programme.sub-title: El nuevo tráiler de la película de Terrance y Philip

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Profesor Caos
programme.desc: Los chicos echan del grupo a Butters y desatan su lado oscuro.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Liberad al sombrero
programme.desc: Los chicos forman un club para evitar que estropeen sus películas favoritas al remasterizarlas.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: El zurullo más grande del mundo

programme.sub-title: El zurullo más grande del mundo

programme.desc: Un hombre de 32 años llega a South Park y dice que es el Stan del futuro. Cartman se mete en el negocio de la venganza.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Trineo rojo abajo

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Soy un poco de campo
programme.desc: Los chicos tienen que hacer un trabajo sobre los padres fundadores y Cartman se remonta a 1776 y entrega la Declaración de independencia al congreso.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Tullidos locos
programme.desc: Jimmy y Timmy se piensan que una banda que se llama Los tullidos es un club para discapacitados y se hacen miembros.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Papel higiénico
programme.desc: Los chicos vandalizan la casa de su profesora de Plástica con papel higiénico, pero Kyle se siente tan culpable que decide que debe morir.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Culo gordo y cabeza tortita

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Los pequeños detectives
programme.desc: Los chicos crean un club para combatir la delincuencia del pueblo y consiguen encontrar una muñeca perdida.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Casa Bonita

programme.title: En la tierra de sangre y miel

programme.title: San Andreas mega seísmo

programme.title: Historias apocalípticas
programme.desc: Tras sobrevivir a una pandemia mundial, dos hombre con agendas muy distintas, dos mujeres de una colonia de supervivientes, una joven y un hombre forman alianzas cuando sus caminos se cruzan en paisajes postapocalípticos.

programme.title: Vuelo 192

programme.title: Tormenta colosal
programme.desc: When a colossal tectonic shift causes the sea level to start rising, a microbiologist gathers the DNA of as many species as she can, while the military creates an "ark" in a desperate attempt to preserve life on Earth.

programme.desc: Hace 10.000 días, un cometa impactó con la Tierra en pleno océano Pacífico con la fuerza de incontables bombas nucleares, sumiendo al planeta en nieve y hielo.

programme.desc: Karen es la orgullosa hija de Sammy el Toro, un mafioso poderoso de Nueva York. Todo se derrumba cuando Sammy testifica para el gobierno y cambia la historia del crimen organizado de Nueva York. Pero no pensó en el impacto en la vida de su hija.

programme.title: Memoria Negra: La Desaparición De Andrea Illona Budach
programme.desc: Año 2002. Agentes de la Guardia Civil reciben accidentalmente una información sobre un supuesto crimen sin resolver.
programme.sub-title: La Desaparición De Andrea Illona Budach

programme.title: Memoria Negra: Operación San Antonio
programme.desc: La populares fiestas de San Antonio Abad de la localidad mallorquina de Pollença son interrumpidas por el brutal asesinato de Llorenç Colom, golpeado hasta la muerte con un hacha en su domicilio.

programme.title: Grupo 2: Homicidios: Premonición
programme.desc: Es enero de 1990, y el frío hace que cada vez sea más extraño no tener noticias de su madre. Jaime decide visitarla en su propia casa. Al cruzar la puerta, un gran charco de sangre devolverá al aterrorizado muchacho a la más terrible realidad del mundo.

programme.title: Mapas de Asesinatos
programme.desc: George Smith tenía muchos alias. Los necesitaba para sus muchas esposas, a quienes pronto asesinaría para reclamar la herencia. Atrapar a este camaleón fue un desafío gigantesco.

programme.title: Wives with Knives
programme.desc: Nancy es una mujer con un historial de relaciones fallidas. Una infancia dura la ha hecho sentirse rota y poco querida. A sus 43 años, se ha casado y divorciado tres veces.

programme.title: Belleza mortal
programme.desc: Teresa Pérez, una bella cazafortunas, cree que por fin encontró el amor junto a Justyn Rosen, un hombre casado. Cuando el rico hombre de negocios termina la relación con su joven amante, Teresa se venga de Justyn con un secuestro impactante.

programme.title: Las Primeras 72 Horas Tras El Crimen: Secuestrada
programme.desc: Una chica asiática adinerada es secuestrada en Vancouver.

programme.title: Crímenes Audaces: El padrino de Earl Spencer
programme.desc: Dos hombres de negocios británicos vinculados a la corona son víctimas de ladrones de gemas en la ciudad de Nueva York. Pero como Scotland Yard y la policía de Nueva York aprenderían, nada de este crimen es lo que parece ...

programme.title: Crímenes Audaces: La reina de las joyas
programme.desc: Un astuto ladrón de joyas lleva a la policía a una persecución que se extiende por todo el mundo y dura una década. Las autoridades de todo el mundo parecen impotentes mientras persiguen a una mujer brillante que conocen como "la Reina de las Joyas".

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Una familia de cuatro realiza el crucero de sus vidas, pero solo tres regresan a casa. Su desesperada búsqueda de su hija adulta desaparecida comienza, con todas las señales apuntando a un secuestro.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Una joven pareja gana un crucero con todos los gastos pagados con un boleto de rasca y gana. Pero su suerte se agota una vez a bordo, cuando uno de ellos termina asesinado.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: La desaparecida de Nancy: El caso Julie Martin
programme.desc: El 30 de junio de 2014, en Nancy, la policía es llamada a la casa de Julie Martin, una enfermera de 34 años.
programme.sub-title: La desaparecida de Nancy: El caso Julie Martin

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: El pequeño martirio de A10: el caso Inass Touloub
programme.desc: El 11 de agosto de 1987, la policía de Orleans descubre el cadáver magullado de un niño de 4 años detrás de una barandilla en la autopista A10.
programme.sub-title: El pequeño martirio de A10: el caso Inass Touloub

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Disparo a quemarropa: El caso Aurelie Barbot
programme.desc: El 20 de diciembre de 2012, en Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, de 29 años, fue asesinada en la puerta de su casa de un balazo en la cabeza.
programme.sub-title: Disparo a quemarropa: El caso Aurelie Barbot

programme.title: Contra Reloj
programme.desc: La repentina desaparición de Angélique Six sumió a la comunidad de Wambrechies en el caos.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: El 4 de diciembre de 1998, a las tres de la madrugada, unos gendarmes que patrullaban por una pequeña carretera rural descubrieron un automóvil incendiado.

programme.title: Infelices Para Siempre: Nostalgia de Boda
programme.desc: El amor de la maestra de música, Wilma y Richard, restaurantero, es armonía ideal. La música para cuando su hogar de recién casados se vuelve cámara de muerte. Un tipo celoso lleno de maldad que los acecha en su casa resulta ser un terrible asesino.

programme.title: Infelices Para Siempre: Luna de Miel en el Hielo
programme.desc: Diane y Kevin, húerfanos los dos, se casan y encuentran la paz en su familia. Todo se derrumba cuando se encuentra un cuerpo desmembrado en la nieve. ¿Sería su ex celoso o un asesino en acecho? La policía lucha por revelar la obsesión de hielo.
programme.sub-title: Luna de Miel en el Hielo

programme.title: Señales de OVNIs en la Historia Humana
programme.desc: Gracias a la extensa investigación realizada por el erudito Ivan Ceci, hemos descubierto numerosos avistamientos de OVNIs que datan desde el 300 a.C. hasta la actualidad. Este notable hallazgo fue posible gracias a una minuciosa investigación.

programme.title: La Verdad Oculta
programme.desc: Con el investigador Pier Giorgio Caria, exploramos desde los primeros contactos con razas extraterrestres hasta los retos geopolíticos actuales, buscando un despertar y contacto colectivo con nuestros hermanos estelares.

programme.title: La Abducción de las Colinas: El Incidente Zeta Reticuli
programme.desc: Se explora el secuestro de Barney y Betty Hill y el incidente de Zeta reticuli.

programme.title: Fotografías Auténticas de un Extraterrestre: El Caso Caponi
programme.desc: Los encuentros de Caponi con extraterrestres de 1993. Las fotos reales muestran vida extraterrestre.

programme.title: Extraterrestres Ancestrales: El Origen de la Humanidad
programme.desc: La creciente evidencia y los avistamientos de ovnis sugieren contacto con seres extraterrestres que pueden haber influido en los orígenes de la vida humana.

programme.title: Desde el Hombre Polilla hasta los Reptilianos: Una guía de especies alienígenas
programme.desc: Testigos de todo el mundo han tenido encuentros cercanos con razas extraterrestres, dando forma a nuestra imaginación y convirtiéndose en fenómenos culturales.

programme.title: Extraterrestres de las Profundidades
programme.desc: Explora los misterios de las profundidades marinas: anomalías submarinas, abducciones alienígenas, USOs y casos inexplicables que desafían nuestra comprensión.

programme.title: Extraterrestres entre Nosotros: La Teoría de Michael Wolf
programme.desc: Michael K. Wolf comparte 30 años de ideas sobre ovnis, extraterrestres, proyectos gubernamentales y círculos de las cosechas.

programme.title: Encuentros Extraterrestres: Los Grises
programme.desc: ¿Quiénes son los alienígenas grises y cuál es su interés en nuestro mundo? En este documental exploramos los posibles motivos detrás de tres de los encuentros más prolíficos en nuestra historia.

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: Astronautas
programme.desc: Cien kilómetros sobre la superficie de la Tierra se encuentra una frontera invisible : el borde del espacio.

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: Llegar arriba
programme.desc: Lanzar cargamentos al espacio es una tarea muy difícil. Misiles diseñados para ojivas atómicas ahora envían satélites al sistema solar. Es una de las pocas hazañas de la humanidad que no ocurre en la naturaleza.

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: La órbita
programme.desc: La Estación Espacial Internacional es, sin duda, la joya de la corona de la órbita terrestre baja; puesto de observación, laboratorio de investigación y aula.

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: De costa a costa
programme.desc: Nuestra naturaleza marinera se ha traducido bien en la era espacial, buscando navegar hacia lo desconocido en busca de riquezas de un tipo u otro.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul, Steve Khan, Victor Bailey & Peter Erskine
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here. This short-lived band was formed by Austrian keyboardist Joe Zawinul in 1986, following the breakup of his famous “Weather Report” band. Again led by Zawinul, Weather Update consisted of Victor Bailey on bass, Peter Erskine and Robert Thomas Jr. on percussion instruments, and Steve Khan on guitar.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard, Al Grey, Alvin Batiste & Al Casey
programme.sub-title: Freddie Hubbard & The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Hubbard is an American jazz trumpeter whose unmistakable and influential tone contributed to new perspectives for modern jazz and bebop. He was also a well-known part of Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers and is primarily known for playing bebop, hard bop, and post-bop styles from the early '60s onwards.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dionne Warwick
programme.sub-title: Dionne Warwick live at the 27 Club
programme.desc: Dionne Warwick's vocal artistry ranges from voluminous deep register to soft, fragile high notes. She masters the entire range with almost unnerving ease. But more than her strong, warm voice, Dionne's magic is in the silky elegance and the secure delivery with which she tells a story. That's how her, along with composer Burt Bacharach and lyricist Hal David become pioneers of the brand of pop music called “Middle of the Road”, meaning pop that is grippingly simple, but never trite. Sixty of her hits made it into the American charts and sold over 100 million albums worldwide. This amazing 1964 recording from the 27 Club in Knokke, Belgium showcases the 23-year-old star vocalist at the start of her career.

programme.title: Don Cherry, Peter Apfelbaum, Bo Freeman & Joshua Jones
programme.desc: Trumpeter Don Cherry was a musician of great versatility, creating an endless variety of styles and influencing generations of musicians. Multikulti presents a never-before heard mixture of international sounds, from mainstream jazz to reggae, in his first collaboration with the amazing Peter Apfelbaum, one of the most in-demand performers at jazz festivals all over the world.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Ryan Porter & Kamasi Washington
programme.sub-title: Ryan Porter & The West Coast Get Down - BIRD
programme.desc: Los Angeles-born saxophonist Kamasi Washington and trombonist Ryan Porter co-founded West Coast Get Down – a musical collective fusing jazz and funk with hip-hop. It is partly because of this collective that jazz saw a resurgence in Los Angeles, subtly eclipsing the long-established jazz mecca of the world, New York City. The two musicians join forces and take the vibes of Los Angeles to jazz club BIRD in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 9, a profoundly emotional and technically complex work from 1909-1910, is characterized by its sprawling, late-Romantic style, exploring themes of human experience, love, and existential questions against the backdrop of Mahler's own impending death. Audiences are drawn to the symphony's deeply personal expression of vulnerability and its transcendent final movement, which serves as a poignant farewell and a profound exploration of the human condition.

programme.title: Elena Bashkirova, Juliane Banse, Emmanuel Pahud & Claudio Bohorquez
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur. In this concert at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Bashkirova is joined by soprano Juliane Banse, flutist Emmanuel Pahud, cellist Claudio Bohórquez, clarinettist Karl-Heinz Steffens, and pianist Ohad Ben-Ari in a chamber music program dedicated to the music of Mendelssohn and his sister Fanny Hensel. The program opens with Mendelssohn's Piano Trio in D minor, Op. 49. This is followed by a selection of songs: Mendelssohn's Schilflied ‘Auf dem Teich, dem regungslosen', Op. 71 No. 4, and Reiselied ‘Der Herbstwind rüttelt die Bäume', Op. 34 No. 6 Hensel's Vorwurf, Op. 10 No. 2 Verlust, Op. 9 No. 10 and Sehnsucht, Op. 9 No. 7 Mendelssohn's ‘Allnächtlich im Traume seh ich dich', Op. 86 No. 4 ‘Die Liebende schreibt', Op. 86 No. 3 and Nachtlied ‘Vergangen ist der lichte Tag', Op. 71 No. 6. The program continues with Mendelssohn's Seven Songs without Words, for piano four-hands (Op. 62 Nos. 1-6, and Op. 67 No. 1), and comes to a close with Mendelssohn's Three pieces for clarinet, violoncello and piano (arr. Ernst Naumann), comprising Prelude, Op. 35 No. 4, Songs without Words, Op. 53 No. 2, and Duet, Op. 38 No. 6. This performance was recorded in November 2020.

programme.title: Les Dissonances
programme.sub-title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances' string quartet – consisting of David Grimal (violin), Hans Peter Hofmann (violin), David Gaillard (viola), and Xavier Phillips (cello) – performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465, ‘Dissonance' (Op. 10 No. 6). The String Quartet is the last in the set of six quartets that were dedicated to Joseph Haydn. Written between 1782 and 1785, these are also known as the Haydn Quartets (Op. 10). String Quartet No. 19 is remarkable for its slow, dissonant introduction, giving the piece its nickname. This ominous passage suddenly gives way to the bright Allegro in C major. This performance was recorded at Opéra Comique in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Mariss Jansons, Berliner Philharmoniker & Hilary Hahn
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world's finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo's magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák's Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber's Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich's Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979)

programme.desc: Granting behind-the-scenes access into the making of Jimi Hendrix's third and final proper studio album, this documentary includes interviews with the musicians and producers involved in the recording process. programme.desc: This amazing concert brings together some of the true pioneers of rock n roll music including B.B. King, Bo Diddley, Jerry Lee Lewis, Little Richard, James Brown, Fats Domino and. Recorded in Italy in 1989 it features these legendary artists in performance of their best loved tracks such as Papas Got A Brand New Bag, Bo Diddley, Great Balls Of Fire, Whole Lotta Shakin Goin On and Blueberry Hill.At the end of the concert all the performers come together for all-star jam that leaves the audience hollering for more.

programme.title: Def Leppard
programme.desc: Sheffield's finest make their long-awaited debut at London's O2m Arena in November 2018. Marking the 31st anniversary of Hysteria they played the whole of the ground breaking album in chronological order featuring hits like Pour Some Sugar on Me, Animal, Women and the title track. They encored with a selection of other classics including When Love and Hate Collide, Let's Get Rocked and Photograph. Another career defining moment from the band capture in 4K video and 5.1 audio.

programme.title: ZZ Top
programme.desc: With an unchanged line-up stretching back to 1969 and global album sales in excess of 50 million, ZZ Top continue to delight fans around the world with brilliant live concerts and great music. The band has made a number of visits to Montreux over the years and this concert from the 2013 Festival is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies albums such as "Tres Hombres" and "Fandango" through their eighties blockbuster period with "Eliminator" and "Afterburner" and up to their most recent release and return to their blues roots with "La Futura". The middle section of the concert features a jazz-blues tribute to the late Montreux Festival founder Claude Nobs with guest appearances by Mike Flanigin on Hammond Organ and Van Wilks on guitar. ZZ Top, the "lil' ol' band from Texas", are rocking the blues as strongly as ever! Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

The only catch is, they cannot leave the estate for 96 hours, and anyone who enters the grounds must also stay for the duration! With time ticking away, the mismatched dozen are forced to work together to keep the peace and work toward their payday. But, when they have to deal with an untimely death, a kidnapping plot, another corpse, burglars, and then even a visit from the boys in blue, will this hapless clan be able to hold it together or will their dreams of riches be buried with the bodies?
